TestStressSparsenessRatio::test_uniform_.description: Single node; runs c-s `write n=1000 -col n=FIXED(50) -insert row-population-ratio=<spec>` (via ScyllaNode.stress -> docker c-s), SELECT * FROM keyspace1.standard1 and asserts fraction of None cells ~= expected (helper distribution_template, stress_tool_test.py:35-55, pytest.approx abs=delta). Tests the cassandra-stress `row-population-ratio` option (CASSANDRA-9522), i.e. the stress tool's sparseness generator, not scylla behavior; scylla only has to store/return unset cells as null. Spec uniform(5..15)/50, expected null fraction 0.8 +-0.1.
